errors.evidence: The orange line, representing "38.2. Обработване и обезвреждане на отпадъци", starts in 2018 at a value visibly below the halfway point (115) between 100 and 130. The value is closer to 112-114. The estimate of "около 120" (around 120) is a significant overestimation.

The grey line, representing "38.3. Рециклиране на материали", starts at 160 in 2018. It dips in 2020, but the value at that point is visibly higher than the 160 mark from 2018. The description incorrectly states that the value drops to around 160, when it is closer to 165.
